scope: Five review findings: repeated sparse copies, heap acceptance quantity, small undo slices, unchanged tail ownership, UTF16 copy throughput. E006 metadata milestone remains open.
inputLimit: Observational single-run comparison; no E002 calibrated speedup claim. Some report analysis/artifact compression overlapped the run; see input summary.

stringAcceptance.quantity: baseline-subtracted string, concatenated string, sliced string self_size across the isolate

runtimeSourceDigestMethod: sha256 over sorted repo-relative path, NUL, content, NUL of all src/**/*.ts excluding *.test.ts, including untracked files.

mixed.note: Unique string nodes reachable from inverse edit text, including sliced/cons parents. Other owners can share these bytes; this is not exclusive retained size.

survivors.note: Unique string nodes reachable from inverse edit text, including sliced/cons parents. Other owners can share these bytes; this is not exclusive retained size.

limits: Inverse copies are bounded to 1024 UTF16 units per edit; larger payloads retain their existing path.
String categories are whole-isolate shallow sums including backing nodes, not exclusive document retained bytes.
Full workspace/core suites were not repeated; prior baseline failures remain documented.
